body.p:
One day Wetyamʟi was in the bush. He saw a bee. He threw his stick at it in order to kill it, but he missed and the stick fell to the ground with a loud noise. He went to see what the trouble was and found that instead of killing a bee he had killed a deer. He skinned it, prepared the
meat and ate it. Then he continued on his way. While he rode his horse's rear foot slipped into a hole full of honey; he removed his horse's hoof and sucked it. Then he went on his way. A little further on he saw a lachiwana- bee. Without saying a word he killed it and ate the honey. He ate so much honey he started to choke, so he ran to a pool and drank some water to get the honey down. When he felt better he remounted and attempted to follow a deer. But in the pursuit his horse's testicles rolled themselves around a palo santo and broke the tree down. The tree in falling crushed the horse.
